From 9f7d09fe23a0112c08d2326d9116fccb5a912660 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yoshihiro Shimoda <yoshihiro.shimoda.uh@renesas.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2022 10:01:07 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] iommu/ipmmu-vmsa: Fix compatible for rcar-gen4

Fix compatible string for R-Car Gen4.

Fixes: ae684caf465b ("iommu/ipmmu-vmsa: Add support for R-Car Gen4")
Signed-off-by: Yoshihiro Shimoda <yoshihiro.shimoda.uh@renesas.com>
Reviewed-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220617010107.3229784-1-yoshihiro.shimoda.uh@renesas.com
Signed-off-by: Joerg Roedel <jroedel@suse.de>

diff --git a/drivers/iommu/ipmmu-vmsa.c b/drivers/iommu/ipmmu-vmsa.c
index 8fdb84b3642b..1d42084d0276 100644
--- a/drivers/iommu/ipmmu-vmsa.c
+++ b/drivers/iommu/ipmmu-vmsa.c
@@ -987,7 +987,7 @@ static const struct of_device_id ipmmu_of_ids[] = {
 		.compatible = "renesas,ipmmu-r8a779a0",
 		.data = &ipmmu_features_rcar_gen4,
 	}, {
-		.compatible = "renesas,rcar-gen4-ipmmu",
+		.compatible = "renesas,rcar-gen4-ipmmu-vmsa",
 		.data = &ipmmu_features_rcar_gen4,
 	}, {
 		/* Terminator */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iommu/ipmmu-vmsa.c`**
   - The compatible string for the R-Car Gen4 device was modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```c
     .compatible = "renesas,rcar-gen4-ipmmu",
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     .compatible = "renesas,rcar-gen4-ipmmu-vmsa",
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `ipmmu-vmsa.c` file corrects the compatible string for the R-Car Gen4 IOMMU device. This change is intended to ensure that the device is properly recognized and supported by the system, addressing a bug introduced in a previous commit (ae684caf465b) that added support for R-Car Gen4. The fix enhances the compatibility of the driver with the hardware, ensuring that it functions correctly with the intended device.
